C-STABILIZE-LINK-ALIASES.Summary: Preserve legitimate absolute local links through a document-directory alias while retaining the canonical document fence and executable guards.
C-STABILIZE-LINK-ALIASES.ApprovalBasis: Owner-approved stabilization recovery delegates fixes for concrete CI regressions. PR 199 reproduces a sibling-link denial when macOS reports the same directory through /var and /private/var.

Goals.Goal: Relative, canonical-absolute and document-alias-absolute sibling links resolve to the same validated target.
Outward traversal, outward symlinks and dangerous requested/resolved names remain denied.

Constraints.Item: Keep M-010 global path policy, HTTP routing, opener transport, dependencies and prior archived assertions unchanged.

NonGoals.Item: No broad path-policy redesign, release, version or publication.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A real directory-symlink fixture reproduces the CI class before the repair and passes afterward; existing local-link/security tests and the intact native suite pass.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Red/green alias fixture, selected final native command, unchanged rejection guards and fresh hosted checks.
